basic_details.job_title: Kerala High Court Office Attendant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 17 Posts

application_fee.details: Candidates should either use system generated Fee Payment Challan or pay online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI. Bank transaction charges, if applicable, must be borne by the candidate. Payment of fee by Demand Draft, Cheque, Money Orders, Postal Orders, etc., will not be accepted. Fee once paid is non-refundable.

age_limit.details: Candidates born between 02/01/1986 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply, with specific relaxations as follows: | Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes: Candidates born between 02/01/1981 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. Other Backward Classes: Candidates born between 02/01/1983 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. Ex-servicemen / Ex-GREF / Disembodied Territorial Army: Can exclude the period of service in defense forces, GREF, or Territorial Army, and the period of unemployment on discharge up to a maximum of five years, provided the candidate has not completed 50 years of age.

qualification.details: Candidates must be qualified Indian Citizens. | Suitable categories of benchmark disabilities: (a) Blindness & Low vision (b) Deaf and Hard of Hearing (c) Locomotor Disability including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, with minimum one functional arm and leg each (d) Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild, Moderate), Intellectual Disability (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness (40% to 70%) (e) Multiple disability involving above combinations. | Minimum functional requirement: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Manipulation by Fingers, Seeing.

vacancy_details.details: There are a total of 17 (Seventeen) anticipated vacancies for the post of Office Attendant. Vacancies that may arise during the period of validity of the ranked list shall also be filled up from the list. As per Rule 11(2) of the Kerala High Court Service Rules, 2007 and in accordance with G.O. (P) No. 5/2023/SJD dated 01.10.2023, 4% of vacancies in the category of Office Attendant are reserved for eligible differently abled candidates.

selection_process: Selection will be on the basis of Written Test and Interview.
The written test will be of Objective Type to be answered in an OMR Answer Sheet with a total duration of 75 minutes and 100 marks. Each question carries 1 mark. For every incorrect answer
1/4 mark will be deducted. The medium of the test will be bilingual in English & Malayalam.
The interview carries 10 marks. The minimum marks required for being included in the ranked list is 35% in the interview.
how_to_apply: Complete 'One Time Registration' using the 'One Time Registration Login' link on the website www.hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in before applying.
Read the notification and 'How to apply' instructions carefully, and keep scanned images of your photograph and signature ready.
Ensure the passport size photograph has a white/light colored background with the face and shoulder clearly visible and centrally focused.
Enter the required details in 'My Profile', then click 'Apply Now' in the 'Dashboard' to apply for the post.
Check the preview of the application carefully before submission, as no changes can be made after final submission.
Complete the application fee payment online or via system-generated fee payment challan.
Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted online through the recruitment portal; no other means or modes of applications will be accepted. Candidates must not possess graduation as on the date fixed for closure of online application filing. Shortlisted candidates must submit an affidavit confirming this. Candidates applying from abroad must forward an email detailing their location with public IP address to [email protected] to get access to the recruitment portal. Caste, Community, Non-Creamy Layer, or EWS certificates must be valid on the date fixed for closure of filing of online application or on the date of certificate verification. Canvassing in any form will entail cancellation of candidature. Misbehavior or malpractice during the written test or interview will lead to disqualification or debarment. Admission to the written test and interview is purely provisional based on online application details.

content_sections.heading: Kerala High Court Office Attendant Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 17 (Seventeen) anticipated vacancies for the post of Office Attendant. Vacancies that may arise during the period of validity of the ranked list shall also be filled up from the list. As per Rule 11(2) of the Kerala High Court Service Rules, 2007 and in accordance with G.O. (P) No. 5/2023/SJD dated 01.10.2023, 4% of vacancies in the category of Office Attendant are reserved for eligible differently abled candidates.

content_sections.heading: Kerala High Court Office Attendant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be qualified Indian Citizens. Suitable categories of benchmark disabilities: (a) Blindness & Low vision (b) Deaf and Hard of Hearing (c) Locomotor Disability including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, with minimum one functional arm and leg each (d) Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild, Moderate), Intellectual Disability (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness (40% to 70%) (e) Multiple disability involving above combinations. Minimum functional requirement: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Manipulation by Fingers, Seeing.

rows.qualification_required: Should have passed S.S.L.C or equivalent and should not have acquired graduation. All qualifications must be acquired on or before the date of closure of filing of online application.

content_sections.heading: Kerala High Court Office Attendant Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates born between 02/01/1986 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply, with specific relaxations as follows: Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes: Candidates born between 02/01/1981 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. Other Backward Classes: Candidates born between 02/01/1983 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. Ex-servicemen / Ex-GREF / Disembodied Territorial Army: Can exclude the period of service in defense forces, GREF, or Territorial Army, and the period of unemployment on discharge up to a maximum of five years, provided the candidate has not completed 50 years of age.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Kerala High Court Office Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment notification issued by the High Court of Kerala to fill 17 anticipated vacancies for the post of Office Attendant under Recruitment Number 21/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Kerala High Court Office Attendant 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 (Seventeen) anticipated vacancies available for the post of Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Kerala High Court Office Attendant 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for closure of filing of online application and remittance of application fee through online mode is 26/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Kerala High Court Office Attendant?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed S.S.L.C or equivalent and should not have acquired graduation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Kerala High Court Office Attendant 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates born between 02/01/1986 and 01/01/2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply, with upper age limit relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, Ex-servicemen, and other specified categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Kerala High Court Office Attendant?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500/- for general candidates. Candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and unemployed differently abled candidates are exempted from fee payment.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Kerala High Court Office Attendant 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete One Time Registration and submit online applications through the official recruitment portal at www.hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Kerala High Court Office Attendant?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test (objective type for 100 marks with 75 minutes duration) and an Interview carrying 10 marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the scale of pay for Kerala High Court Office Attendant?
faq.answer: The scale of pay for the post is ₹23000 – ₹50200.

faq.question: Q10. When will the written examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The exact date of the written examination is not specified in the notification. Admission tickets will be ready for download three weeks prior to the date of the test.
